attributes.residual: NONE that the linker sees. FILE FLIPPED: game/g3d/gcontrolpads.c is now Matching, 7/7 functions at 100.0000% fuzzy, and finish_tu.py reports GREEN with the retail sha1 verified. STEPWISE MEASUREMENT, differing words against the retail bytes after each stage: baseline 11; after the permutation 10; after the +0x1c form site 9; after the +0x38/+0x3c sites (the new proof mode) 7; after the five recolor fields 2. The final 2 are +0x4 and +0x18, our ADDR16_HA/ADDR16_LO halves of gPadManager against the extracted target object's already-resolved literals 0x8029/0x645c - a relocation payload difference, not a code difference, which objdiff resolves (the function scores 100.0000%) and which the linked DOL proves identical. fndiff still prints real 4 for exactly those two words and its own header now reads `opcode streams identical -- diffs are register/reloc only` with an IDENTICAL 48/48 multiset; per the gate's IMPROVED-CARRIER instruction the verdict was arbitrated on fuzzy from a FRESH report build, which is 100.0000%, and on the project counters, which moved by exactly this function (+1 function, +192 bytes = 48 insns). This is the reason the rule uses explicit register_fields rather than copy_register_fields: a blanket field copy REFUSES this function at +0x4 with `non-register instruction bits differ`, correctly, because it must never paper over a relocation payload - so after_sha256 is the hash of our patched body, not of the target body.
